summary: The best AI tools for content creation in 2026: 12 tools for posts, images, video and voice, compared by job, free plan and price. Find the one for you.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI tool for content creation?


Start from the format you publish, then decide whether you write, generate or edit footage, count the AI use you need each month, and check watermarks and commercial rights, in that order.


1.


### 1


Name the format


A post, a short, a long video or a podcast each point to a different kind of tool, and ads and[faceless YouTube channels](https://flick.art/blog/best-ai-tools-for-faceless-youtube-channels) have their own picks, as in our guide to[AI tools for ad creatives](https://flick.art/blog/best-ai-tools-for-ad-creatives) .


2.


### 2


Find the source


Writing tools start from words, generators start from a prompt and editors start from footage you shot, so pick the kind that matches what you have when you sit down.


3.


### 3


Count the AI use


Credits, media hours and usage limits each run out differently, so price the posts, clips and voiceovers you will actually make in a month, retries included.


4.


### 4


Check rights and marks


Watermarks, export resolution and commercial licenses often change between the free and paid plans, so check them before you publish client or brand work.
